title: Rubik's Cube world record solve time, 1982-2023
notes: Official competitive records fell from the first championship's 22.95 seconds in 1982 through roughly 20 seconds by 2000 to 3.47 seconds in 2018 (Yusheng Du) and about 3.13 seconds in recent years (Max Park).
